entities.name: Abbad ibn Bishr
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: ʿAbbād ibn Bishr was a companion of the Islamic prophet Muhammad. After the Hijrah of Muhammad and his followers from Mecca, 'Abbād and his clansmen were given the name al-Ansar for their assistance in providing shelter to the Muslims who came to their town. His Kunya was Abu al-Rabi'.
